subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. The selections prioritize high relevance, strong peer validation through view counts, and educational clarity. For 'MAC, IP, and Port Addressing' in Arabic, a lower-view but perfectly relevant video was chosen over higher-view but less focused alternatives. For 'Data Encapsulation' in Arabic, many candidates were correctly identified as being about OOP and were excluded.

coverage.note: Many candidates were about OOP encapsulation and thus irrelevant. Others failed duration or view count gates.

videos.title: OSI Model Explained | OSI Animation | Open System Interconnection Model | OSI 7 layers | TechTerms
videos.filter_reason: Excellent animated explanation with massive view count (6.2M), covering all seven layers clearly, making it a perfect starting point.

videos.title: REAL LIFE example!! (TCP/IP and OSI layers) // FREE CCNA // EP 4
videos.filter_reason: This video uses a highly effective real-life example to trace a packet's journey, perfectly illustrating the encapsulation process in an engaging way.

videos.title: IP Address, MAC Address, and Port Address: A Comprehensive Guide | Computer Network
videos.topic_ar: العنونة باستخدام MAC و IP والمنافذ
videos.filter_reason: Perfectly matches the topic by providing a comprehensive guide to all three addressing types (IP, MAC, and Port), which is crucial for clearing up student confusion.

videos.title: Lec-4: TCP/IP Protocol Suite | Internet Protocol Suite | OSI vs TCP/IP
videos.filter_reason: With over 2.1M views, this concise and highly relevant video provides an excellent, peer-validated overview of the TCP/IP protocol suite.
